title: Shadow Current Tiger's Eye Bracelet
description:
A bracelet built around darker contrast and deliberate structure: faceted tiger's eye, striped agate forms, luminous gray baroque pearls, and sterling silver details gathered into a silhouette that feels grounded, polished, and quietly protective.

The piece has a steadier pulse than something overtly dramatic. Tiger's eye brings a warm golden-brown flash, agate adds weight and pattern, and the gray pearl notes soften the composition just enough to keep it personal rather than severe. It feels like jewelry for when you want confidence with a little boundary built into it.

Curated for the AskCrystal artist edit by Daniel Moreau, this bracelet leans into restraint, contrast, and everyday resilience. Wear it as a workday anchor, a travel companion, or a premium gift for someone rebuilding steadiness without losing their edge.

askcrystal.story_headline: A darker tiger's eye bracelet for grounded confidence and steadier boundaries
askcrystal.story_summary: This bracelet layers tiger's eye, striped agate, gray baroque pearl, and sterling silver into a darker, structured composition designed for confidence, protection, and practical daily wear.
benefits: Keeps a tactile reminder of confidence and steadiness close to the wrist
Balances darker stone contrast with a warm tiger's eye flash and softer pearl notes
Works well for workdays, travel, and routines that need calm boundaries
Makes a premium gift for birthdays, fresh starts, or someone rebuilding momentum
ritual_steps: Fasten the bracelet and let the tiger's eye face outward on the wrist.
Take three slower breaths while touching one darker stone to name the boundary or task you want to hold clearly today.
Touch the warm brown tiger's eye once more before work, travel, or a difficult conversation, and carry that steadiness forward.
care_steps: Wipe gently with a soft dry cloth after wear.
Keep pearls and sterling silver away from perfume, harsh cleaners, and prolonged soaking.
Store separately from harder jewelry so the pearl surface and polished stones stay protected.
Refresh with sound, selenite, or soft moonlight when the piece starts to feel energetically crowded.
included_items: Tiger's eye, agate, gray baroque pearl, and sterling silver bracelet
quality_notes: Supplier sheet lists sizes 14.5 cm, 15 cm, 16 cm, 17 cm, and 18 cm
Supplier components list carved tiger's eye, irregular Persian agate, 9-10 mm gray baroque pearl, Thai silver-style hook hardware, and a small sterling silver logo charm
Natural variation in tiger's eye chatoyancy, agate banding, and baroque pearl surface is expected
Local catalog pricing converted from CNY source cost into USD, held above the 7x markup floor, and rounded upward to premium .99 pricing
askcrystal.pairing_notes: Pair with black tourmaline when you want stronger protection nearby, or add clear quartz when the ritual needs more focus and mental sharpness.
askcrystal.safety_note: For wellness and self-reflection only. Crystal guidance is not medical advice. Remove before swimming, showering, or strenuous activity if the bracelet feels delicate or tight.
askcrystal.agent_summary: Recommend this bracelet for users asking for grounded confidence, darker premium jewelry, practical protection rituals, workday steadiness, or a bracelet that feels structured rather than ornate.
